pages.text: Wants a room: walls, a floor and a ceiling, with no way out to the sky. At least 27 blocks of space.$(p)Grants:$(li)sword damage, growing with the tier, up to +30%%.$(p)Tiers begin at a score of 5.
Will not count without:$(li)1 of any smithing$(p)Rewards, most first:$(li)any smithing$(li)any anvil$(li)any armament$(li)any storage$(li)any lighting$(p)Counts against it:$(li)any bookshelves

pages.text: None of this is required, but building it well earns more than the blocks alone:$(li)Armament is 0-4 from forge, and storage is within 5 of forge.
